title: R' Shimon bar Avudama

paragraphs: Hyman says this name appears in Otzar Yisrael’s list of Amoraim, citing Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 5:2. He calls it an error and says the passage reads Rabbi Shmuel bar Avudama.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud paragraph names Shmuel bar Evduma, corresponding to the patronymic abbreviated ב״א here. The author initials מכ״א remain unidentified.

The supplied מכ״א and earlier OCR מניא remain unresolved source variants. Reading a verb מביא, is cited, is plausible, but neither the letters nor an initialled author are established. The earlier categorical author-initial claim is withdrawn as an identification, without replacing it with a proved glyph history. The prior consulted Pesachim5:2 Shmuel bar Evduma comparison supports contextual ב״א as bar Avudama rather than bar Abba; that paragraph and Otzar Yisrael were not newly inspected. Hyman owns the Shimon-to-Shmuel error claim at full force. Both personal-title abbreviations remain R'.

Hyman’s print (vol. III, p. 1156) reads כן מביא, “this is cited,” where the supplied transcription has מכ״א. The consulted Pesachim 5:2 explicitly names Rabbi Shmuel bar Evduma. Hyman abbreviates the patronymic as ב״א. The exact entry in Otzar Yisrael remains to be collated.
